method: The loopback metric is the observed host X11 held-key release edge minus viewer F12 issuance on one monotonic clock. The two-machine metric is viewer issuance to viewer receipt of the matching host observer reply using the viewer clock at both endpoints of the interval. It is an upper bound on host edge latency and includes observer delivery back to the viewer. Host monotonic timestamps are retained independently as causal evidence. Per-session nearest-rank p95 uses the full planned sample budget and gives unverified samples infinite rank; it is unbounded unless the p95 rank is reachable with verified observations. Successful-only summaries are descriptive. The physical input-to-pixel target is outside the measurement scope.
